caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of woven or embroidered fabric with frayed edges, positioned on a plain, light-colored background. The central design features a bouquet of flowers, including various shapes and sizes of blossoms and leaves in colors such as pink, yellow, white, green, and red, set against an oval, dark, almost black background. Surrounding the bouquet is an ornate border of large, stylized leaves in brown, tan, beige, and muted green tones, with some decorative gold elements at the top. The overall fabric area outside the central motif is a bright, gradient red, fading from darker to lighter tones. The upper edge of the fabric appears worn and fringed, and the bottom edge of the patterned section is uneven, suggesting partial wear or missing areas. The composition is centered with the ornamental pattern occupying the main visual space, and there are no visible human figures or additional objects depicted.
